id: title:Radu-Raicea:preserve generation outputs in judge transcripts

review.posthog_relevance: Changes the trace evaluation to preserve complete generation outputs before truncating, preventing the judge from grading formatting artifacts as model mistakes.
review.reason: Adds a new option `preserve_generation_output` to `FormatterOptions` and its use in session and trace evaluation, while retaining existing truncation behavior. P1.F1.H1: Documentation updated to describe the new fallback behavior. P1.F2.H1: Docstring updated to preserve generation outputs before truncating. P1.F2.H2: Loop and conditional changed to support three-stage formatting: P
review.uncertainty: The benefit relies on the downstream evaluation system correctly utilizing the preserved output; this is not demonstrated by the implementation alone. No production incident or adoption is inferred.

observations.limitations: This chunk is a single, complete change group. No missing context or unrelated PRs detected. No score assigned; tier assignment requires a score, not an observation-only JSON.
